item.title: Ash Wednesday : Local immigrant children pray for families to be reunited
item.description: Ash Wednesday is a Holy Day of Obligation in the Catholic Church. item.title: Caltech scientist fatally shot in the Antelope Valley
item.description: A 67-year-old Caltech scientist was fatally shot in the Antelope Valley community of Llano.The shooting occurred around 6:10 a.m. Monday, Feb. 16 in the 30700 block of 165th Street East, according to the LA County Sheriff's department. Deputies responded to a 911 call of an assault with a deadly weapon and found the victim on the front porch suffering from a gunshot wound. He was pronounced dead at the scene.
